description:
Ever wondered what's actually happening inside your outlet, your phone charger, or the power grid?
Hidden Current explains the invisible engineering behind everyday things in short, clear videos with accurate animations. No jargon, no fluff.
You'll learn:
⚡ How electricity actually works, from outlets and breakers to batteries and chargers
⚡ What's inside the electronics you use every day
⚡ How the power grid keeps the lights on
⚡ Why things fail, and the engineering that keeps you safe
New Shorts every week. Subscribe if you've ever looked at something and thought, "how does that work?"
📩 Business inquiries: belal.automates@gmail.com
